name: Pramara Promotions Ltd.
summary: Pramara Promotions Ltd. is an India-based integrated manufacturer and solutions provider specializing in the toys and promotional products industry. The company operates as a promotional marketing agency, offering end-to-end solutions from ideation and product development to large-scale manufacturing and global sourcing. Its services encompass consumer promotions, trade promotions, brand partnerships, character licensing, corporate gifting, loyalty and rewards programs, e-commerce solutions, experiential rewards, and point-of-sale marketing. Pramara Promotions manufactures plastic promotional products and toys, as well as designs and produces non-plastic items through its approved vendor network. The company primarily targets multinational corporations across diverse sectors including Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG), Quick Service Restaurants (QSR), pharmaceutical, personal care, telecom, retail, petroleum, liquor, paint, food, logistics, construction, beauty, and media. Headquartered in Mumbai, India, the company also has manufacturing facilities in Daman, India, and has established operations and OEM partnerships in the USA.
